thread:
natalie.sales: Quick heads-up	6 Stonebridge Capital's vendor security review sent a SIG/CAIQ request asking for IAM/access-control evidence. They want SAML config, MFA enforcement proof, RBAC roles.csv, SCIM provisioning logs, service account controls, and redacted auth logs. They want it by Wed COB. Can we put a package together?

aaron.security: Yep. Suggested artifacts: SAML metadata file + integration notes, screenshots of MFA policies including conditional access rules, RBAC matrix CSV with a least-privilege rationale per role, SCIM change log sample, redacted auth/audit log (with mfa events), service-account policy doc (rotation + issuance flow), and a one-page summary for reviewers.

lina.eng: I can grab the RBAC CSV and admin UI screenshots. I'll redact usernames and tenant IDs. Where should I upload? Prefer secure S3 path.

kevin.sre: For the POC, we can spin up a demo org and create a scoped service account to validate role permissions and SCIM sync. I'll produce ephemeral client certs and a link to a signed CSR. Who will approve sharing the demo access with Stonebridge SRE?

aaron.security: Approvals: sales needs to request access, Engineering/SEC must approve. Do NOT share PEMs in Slack. Kevin, put creds in Vault: secret/sales/stonebridge/poc and set TTL to 12 hours. We'll give least-privileged rights. Also document conditional access for human logins (MFA + device compliance).

tom.solutions: I'll draft the cover letter for the SIG response. Include controls mapping (SIG question -> artifact name) and a contact for technical follow-up. Also add a short paragraph explaining our stance on service account MFA.

lina.eng: Quick note on service accounts: we don't require interactive MFA. Controls for non-interactive identities: mutual TLS for machine-to-service, short TTL tokens issued by our token broker, mandatory key rotation every 30 days, and IP restrictions for privileged service accounts. We'll provide config snippets and a sample rotation log.

aaron.security: Good. Also prepare a redacted sample showing "challenge_mfa" and "mfa_passed" events in the auth log for a human user. For the service account, include issuance events and rotation entries.

kevin.sre: SCIM details: we support SCIM v2 with group-to-role mappings. I'll export a redacted provisioning event stream (create/update/delete) and a sample PATCH that demonstrates group sync to RBAC roles.

lina.eng: Uploaded roles.csv and UI screenshots to s3://redwood-secure/sales/stonebridge/iam/. Shared bucket link with limited ACL. Aaron, please review before we hand over.

aaron.security: Reviewing now. I'll stamp the bundle with our internal approval token and append an internal reviewer note. Also adding the admin change-approval workflow (PR-based changes + 2 approvers) and the break-glass procedure.

tom.solutions: I'll assemble the zip: artifacts, one-pager, and a short readme for Stonebridge. Plan: internal review tomorrow 09:30, deliver Wed afternoon. Natalie, can you coordinate schedule with the customer for a possible 30-min POC call if they want live validation?

natalie.sales: Yes	6 I'll ask if they need a live demo. Aiming to send the bundle Wed PM. Please ack when your uploads and approvals are done. :thumbsup:

aaron.security: ack	6 artifacts reviewed and approval token added.

lina.eng: ack	6 uploads complete and redactions applied.

kevin.sre: ack	6 vault secret created and demo org ready. Will share Vault link after final approval.

tom.solutions: ack	6 cover note draft will be posted in this thread by 08:00 tomorrow.

natalie.sales: Thanks everyone. If Stonebridge asks about enforcing MFA on service accounts specifically, we'll point them to the machine-identity controls and offer a short design review to accommodate stricter policies (e.g., mTLS + hardware-backed certs).
